title: Social Assistance Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Social Assistance Act', consolidation date November 21, 2018. Cover page prints 'SOCIAL ASSISTANCE ACT / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.S-10' (French: 'LOI SUR L'ASSISTANCE SOCIALE / L.R.T.N.-O. 1988, ch. S-10'), amended through S.N.W.T. 2018,c.21, with the standard 'not an official statement of the law' office-consolidation notice. Not marked repealed. Administering department per the October 13, 2025 table: Education, Culture and Employment.
notes: The territory's income-support / last-resort assistance statute. Unemployment benefits are federal (Employment Insurance Act, S.C. 1996, c. 23), as are the Canada Child Benefit and GST credit. The register also carries a Senior Citizens Benefits Act (consolidation of March 30, 2015) for the NWT Senior Citizens Supplementary Benefit; Social Assistance is the principal general benefits statute.
